row.name: Kidz Explorer Daycare and Learning Center, LLC

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Two out of four staff files reviewed have certificates that are not equivalent to a high school diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: One out of four staff files reviewed is missing safe sleep / shaken baby training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Rodent droppings were observed on the kitchen floor and cabinets and a dead rat/mouse was found in a sticky strap inside a storage room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Based on the information obtained during the course the investigation, permit holder's actions resulted in multiple deficiencies and included the provision of a forged document.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Pest Extermination: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, building was treated for pests by a non-licensed individuals and operation was not treated by a licensed company during an on-going rodent issue.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.3427)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, an individual with an ineligible background check determination has been present at the operation during operational hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two caregivers were providing care for five children in the toddler room. The youngest child is 8mo and oldest is 30 months old. Age difference between youngest and oldest child exceeds 18 months. There were a total of 15 children present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, staff were instructed to delay diaper / soiled clothes changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, a child was scorned by staff for having toilet training related accidents and child was threatened to receive a tongue injection for saying bad words.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: Policies were reviewed and the following information is missing:     (B) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect;    (C) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect; and    (E) Actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to obtain assistance and intervention, including procedures for reporting child abuse or neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One out of four staff / contractor files reviewed is missing start date, orientation / policies received statements, preemployment affidavit and notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: A child was placed in a high chair after misbehaving.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider removed child from high chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Prek classroom was observed out of control. Children were hiting each other, climbing onto furniture and window sill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A total of 13 children were present at the operation. 6 children ages 15mo-35mo were combined in the toddler room. The age difference between the youngest child and oldest child exceed 18 months.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when one oldest child was moved to the prek room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours: Children's attenance records incluing time of arrival / departure and employee or parent initials were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours (26 TAC §746.805(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One out of six staff training records reviewed is missing 12 of annual training including 1 hr of Abuse / Neglect training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Meal preparation, except when 12 or fewer children are in care: A staff member counted towards ratio stepped out of room and into the kitchen to prepare breakfast.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Meal preparation, except when 12 or fewer children are in care (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(B))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two staff members were providing care for 13 children ages 11mo to 4yo4mo. Age difference between youngest and oldest child was 41 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Six staff files were reviewed. One file is missing start date, center and personnel policies statement and orientation. Second file is missing  foreign high school diploma. Third file is missing start date. Fourth file is start date, high school diploma, personnel / center policies statement, orientation and annual trainings (if applicable).     Three out of six files reviewed are missing pre-employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Children were observed crying, climbing onto furniture, hitting each other and throwing toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two staff members were providing care for 14 children ages 11mo to 3yo3mo. Age difference between youngest and oldest child was 27 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge: Staff member designated as person in charge was not aware of the assignment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, children were out of control and without proper supervision. Children were observed crying, getting up from their chairs during breakfast, throwing toys and climbing onto furniture. A 3yo child was left unsupervised in the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Based on the information obtained during the course of the inspection, food items served during breakfast meal did not meet the meal patterns established by the U.S. Department of Agriculture Child and Adult Care Food Program.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, cleaning products are kept accessible to children. Cleaning products were observed on a low cabinet in the restroom and children were observed using restroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: Operational policies were reviewed and the following items are missing:    (18)(A) Benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;  (18) (B) The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;  (18) (F) The criteria you will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play;  (30) Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: A person in charge was designated during Director's absence, however, person in charge was absent at arrival and no other person had been designated as person in charge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: One out of two toilets in the girl's toddler restroom is out of service. The same toilet was observed dirty as well as the urinal in the boy's toddler restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: Exits out of the toddler and prek rooms were blocked with bookcases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: Broken toys and pieces of broken plastic were observed in the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: Children in the prek room were observed crying, screaming, fighting and throwing toys. Children were not observed participating in planned activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: A person in charge was not designated during Director's absence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, classrooms were out of control. Children were observed wandering in and out of classroom and climbing onto furniture.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the information obtained during the of course the investigation, Directors failed to guide operation into compliance and were regularly absent during transition times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, operation's playground had broken toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, caregivers step in and out of classrooms to tend to parent's needs during pick up time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, it was determined floors were not regularly cleaned and a rug was observed with multiple stains.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A total of 15 children were present at the operation. A group of six children were combined for naptime ranging from 16mo to 3yo. Age different is over 18months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three staff training reviewed and missing trainings on the following topics:    Food Allergies  Administering Medications  Communicable Diseases  Building and Physical Premises Safety
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One out of six staff training records reviewed has a first aid / CPR certification that expired 4/7/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Six staff trainings records were reviewed. One of the files was not available for review at the time of the inspection. Two of the files are missing trainings on the following topics:    Hazardous Materials  Food Allergies  Administering Medications  Emergency Preparednesses  Communicable Diseases  Building and Physical Premises Safety
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Last Fire Inspection was conducted on 06/21/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, it was found that staff has placed children in highchairs and used safety straps to prevent children from getting up during time-out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was caring for 7 children ages 6mo, 7mo, 8mo, 13mo, 13mo, 14mo, 14mo.     Note: A substitute caregiver arrived to operation to assist in the infant-age classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

Cribs and play-yards in the infant room are not labeled with  the children's names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Napping Floor Mats Marked with Sleeping Side Distinguished (26 TAC §746.4503(c))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))
